title: The Importance of Being Earnest
author: Oscar Wilde
summary: Two Victorian gentlemen invent alter egos to escape their obligations, then end up courting women who each insist on marrying a man named Ernest. The play is a farce of mistaken identity.
readIf: you want a short comedy full of epigrams that mocks Victorian manners.
skipIf: you want emotional realism rather than an artificial farce.
